description: This Dart source file provides a utility class for managing persistent storage using SharedPreferences. It defines keys and methods to set and get user onboarding completion status and username, encapsulating SharedPreferences interactions.

classes.name: StorageKeys
classes.description: Defines static constant keys used for storing onboarding completion status and username.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Provides static methods to initialize SharedPreferences, and get/set user onboarding status and username.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Stores whether onboarding has been completed.

methods.name: getOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Retrieves whether onboarding has been completed.

methods.name: _ensure
